meta.name: Repair Drone
meta.description: Lets loose a little drone that flies to the nearest friendly tank, hovers over it and patches its armour: 15 HP on arrival, then 10 more at the start of every turn for two rounds, never above its round-start health. It stays on the map while the turns go on, and a shell passing within 4 cells or going off within 24 knocks it out of the sky.
